sourceTitle: Providence: 6. PROVIDENCE HOUSING TRUST FUND TO FINANCE AFFORDABLE MULTI-FAMILY HOUSING PROJECTS IN THE CITY
exactQuestion: Shall an act passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly entitled “An Act authorizing the City of Providence to issue not to exceed $25,000,000 general obligation bonds and notes to fund the Providence Housing Trust Fund to finance Affordable Multi-Family Housing Projects in the City” be approved?
fullQuestionAndExplanationBlock: 6. PROVIDENCE HOUSING TRUST FUND TO FINANCE AFFORDABLE MULTI-FAMILY HOUSING PROJECTS IN THE CITY $25,000,000 BONDS AND NOTES (Local Acts 034/035 – Acts and Resolves of 2026) Shall an act passed at the 2026 session of the General Assembly entitled “An Act authorizing the City of Providence to issue not to exceed $25,000,000 general obligation bonds and notes to fund the Providence Housing Trust Fund to finance Affordable Multi-Family Housing Projects in the City” be approved? 6. sourceTitle: Providence: 7. AN ORDINANCE DIVESTING FROM FOREIGN COUNTRIES CONDUCTING SEVERE VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS
exactQuestion: Shall an Ordinance divesting from foreign countries conducting severe violations of human rights such as ethnic cleansing, apartheid, illegal military occupation, or genocide be approved?
fullQuestionAndExplanationBlock: 7. AN ORDINANCE DIVESTING FROM FOREIGN COUNTRIES CONDUCTING SEVERE VIOLATION OF HUMAN RIGHTS (Resolution 326 adopted by the Providence City Council on July 30, 2026) Shall an Ordinance divesting from foreign countries conducting severe violations of human rights such as ethnic cleansing, apartheid, illegal military occupation, or genocide be approved? 7. SE PROPONE UNA ORDENANZA PARA RETIRAR INVERSIONES DE PAÍSES EXTRANJEROS QUE COMETAN GRAVES VIOLACIONES DE LOS DERECHOS HUMANOS (Resolución 326 adoptada por el Concejo Municipal de Providence el 30 de julio de 2026) ¿Debería aprobarse una ordenanza para retirar inversiones de países extranjeros que cometan graves violaciones de los derechos humanos, como la limpieza étnica, el apartheid, la ocupación militar ilegal o el genocidio?
